messages:
mira: Quick design review for on-prem setup wizard network step. Uploaded a compact bubble mock to collapse probe details: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/onprem-compact. Can folks check keyboard flow, SR announcements, and microcopy? jamal: Saw it. Keyboard focus jumps when probe results update and we swap the detail block tab lands on the small CTA. sophia: Prefer offscreen live region (role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\") and avoid moving focus unless critical. Change copy to: 'Connection timed out try these steps:' + short bullets. alex: DOM swap causes node replacement. Use stable keys (host.id) and hide/show via CSS (data-probe-state) to keep nodes stable. riley: UX: add a tiny tooltip \"Why this matters\" beside status explaining egress/SSH. Rename \"Fix\" -> \"Troubleshooting guide\". jamal: Minimal announcer pattern: `
` then update textContent briefly. Avoid autofocus. mira: Microcopy: change \"Retry probe\" -> \"Retry network check\"; fallback text should list suggested steps rather than \"try again later.\" sophia: I'll run NVDA + keyboard-only checks and verify announcer reads and that yellow status chip meets contrast. alex: For 504 responses propose: \"Gateway timed out try increasing probe timeout or run the quick-probe\". I'll draft an RFC mapping HTTP codes to suggested actions. deploy-bot: preview: https://preview.redwood.com/branches/compact-probe-ux includes live-region + stable keys + CSS min-width patch. Smoke test please. mira: Action items: jamal add live-region + stable keys + avoid DOM swaps; riley add tooltip + copy; sophia run accessibility pass; alex file RFC for 504 wording; I'll update Figma. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: mira: Closing thread; will reopen if previews flag regressions.
